product_metadata.title: Electric Can Opener, Safe Smooth No Sharp Edges Can Opener for Almost Size Cans, Handheld Can Opener Fits Perfect in Drawer, Best Gift for Women, Senior with Arthritis
features: 【SAFE】The blade cuts along the side of the lid without touching the food inside and leaves NO Sharps Edges, which makes cutting safer than the regular opener.

【Easy To Use】Just place the electric can opener on the can and press the button, it will cut cans 360° along the lid automatically. Powered by 2 x AA batteries(battery not included). It’s the best hands-free can-opening solution.
【Suitable For Most Of Cans】 The Kitchenmuh electric can opener is perfect for almost all sizes of cans(excluding rimless cans and peculiar-shaped cans), a great help for the kitchen.

【User-friendly & Ergonomic Design】Just press a button to turn it on and will stop automatically after finish opening. Perfect for left-handed people, disabled people, and people whose hand is suffering pain or arthritis. The perfect size makes it easy to store in a drawer.
【Best Gifts】Professional and safe electric can opener is an ideal kitchen gadget. It is a great gift for your parents, friends, family members or elders, etc.
